Beardslee Beer

All Beardslee beer is brewed on-site in our downstairs brewery. 5oz taster $3; 10oz schooner $6; 13oz tulip $7.50; 16oz pint $8; pitcher $25.

  • Pineapple IPA

    Price: See sizes above

    Pineapple and tropical fruit aromas greet you on the nose with this fruit-forward IPA. Pineapple puree in a moderately hoppy IPA. IBU 55; ABV 5.75%.

  • Four Ginger IPA

    Price: See sizes above

    Greenleaf IPA infused with four different types of ginger: galangal, fresh, pickled and candied ginger. IBU 60; ABV 6.4%.

  • Sour Cherry Ale

    Price: See sizes above

    A kettle sour mash makes this light and refreshing ale, blended and aged with aseptic cherry puree from Oregon Fruit. IBU 18; ABV 5.1%.

  • Greenleaf IPA

    Price: See sizes above

    Hops, hops, hops. Made using hop bursting, this IPA delivers mellow bitterness with strong hop aroma & flavor. IBU 60; ABV 6.4%.

  • Bad Axe IPA

    Price: See sizes above

    Calypso, Trident and Mosaic hops create a dank and luscious Northwest IPA bursting with tropical notes and a long-lasting hoppy finish. IBU 66; ABV 7.2%.

  • Beaver Bait Blonde

    Price: See sizes above

    An easy-drinking ale to quench your thirst and wake up your taste buds. Perfect for people who enjoy lagers, low in malty flavor and hops/bitterness. In logging, “beaver bait” means loose logs. IBU 35; ABV 5.3%.

  • Citra Pale Ale

    Price: See sizes above

    Hoppy, citrus and tropical fruit aromas in a pale and fruity Northwest Pale Ale featuring abundant Citra hops. IBU 38; ABV 5.6%.

  • Ponderosa Pilsner

    Price: See sizes above

    Crisp and refreshing with medium bitterness and pronounced malt and hop flavor. A classic Czechoslovakian-style pilsner for summer or Oktoberfest. IBU 35; ABV 5.2%.

  • At Last Amber

    Price: See sizes above

    An easy-drinking Amber Ale full of fruity flavor, featuring Cascade hops and a smooth malty backbone. IBU 38; ABV 5.75%.

  • Springboard ISA

    Price: See sizes above

    A refreshing India Pale Ale with mild bitterness and lighter alcohol. Lingering hop flavor leaves you anticipating the next sip. IBU 45; ABV 5.5%.

Our Own Small Batch Spirits

Craft spirits from Wildwood Spirits Co., owned by Chef John Howie and Sommelier Erik Liedholm.

  • Kur Gin

    Price: $13

    “The Most awarded Gin in America.” London Dry Gin style, with classic juniper, Seville oranges, Douglas Fir and Braeburn apples. Pronounced “cure”. Food & Wine named Kur Gin as one of the gins to use for a Negroni.

  • Rendition 5 Year Rye

    Price: $18

    “Double Gold Award.” Finished in Dark Door bourbon barrels. Aromas of citrus, cinnamon and baking spice; white pepper, mocha and vanilla flavors with a lengthy, rich finish. Named by Food & Wine as a craft rye for a Classic Manhattan.

  • The Dark Door Bourbon

    Price: $18

    “Double Gold Award.” Organic non-GMO corn, white wheat, and barley from Washington State. Aged in new high-char American oak barrels. Complex notes of toffee, caramel, orange flowers and vanilla.

  • Stark Vatten Vodka

    Price: $13

    “Double Gold Award.” Swedish for “strong water”, this vodka is clean, viscous, and oily, displaying a classic European style while remaining a distinctive local product.

  • The Professor 3 Year

    Price: $18

    American whiskey with an Irish-style mash bill of Washington winter wheat and malt. Light body and texture, with caramel and marzipan around a floral backbone.
